Queries.GetJounalEntrysHead:
SELECT DISTINCT A.TransId
FROM JDT1 A LEFT JOIN OJDT B ON A.TransId=B.TransId WHERE A.RefDate BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20231231' AND U_BO_SocioNegocio IS NULL AND A.TransType IN('13','16','24','59','60','202') AND A.TransId = '' ORDER BY 1
Queries.GetJounalEntrysLines:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT A.TransId, A.Line_ID, A.Account, CASE WHEN A.TransType IN('202','60', '67', '68', '59', '25') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 U_BO_Dflt_CardCode FROM [@BO_CONFIG]) WHEN A.TransType IN('16') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM ORDN WHERE TransId = A.TransId) WHEN A.TransType IN('24') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM ORCT WHERE TransId = A.TransId) WHEN A.TransType IN('13') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM OINV WHERE TransId = A.TransId) WHEN A.TransType IN('14') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM ORIN WHERE TransId = A.TransId) WHEN A.TransType IN('15') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM ODLN WHERE TransId = A.TransId) WHEN A.TransType IN('16') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM ORDN WHERE TransId = A.TransId) WHEN A.TransType IN('18') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM OPCH WHERE TransId = A.TransId) WHEN A.TransType IN('19') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM ORPC WHERE TransId = A.TransId) WHEN A.TransType IN('20') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM OPDN WHERE TransId = A.TransId) WHEN A.TransType IN('21') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM ORPD WHERE TransId = A.TransId)
WHEN A.TransType IN('46') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 CardCode FROM OVPM WHERE TransId = A.TransId)
ELSE U_BO_SocioNegocio END AS "U_BO_SocioNegocio", A.TransType
FROM JDT1 A LEFT JOIN OJDT B ON A.TransId=B.TransId WHERE A.RefDate BETWEEN '20200101' AND '20231231' AND U_BO_SocioNegocio IS NULL AND A.TransType IN('60','67','68','59', '25','24','14','15','16','18','19','20','21', '46', '13','60','202', '30') AND (A.Debit+A.Credit) != 0 ) C WHERE U_BO_SocioNegocio IS NOT NULL AND C.TransId = '%TransId%'
